spans.s:
(औ इर) औ विजिर r. 3rd cl. (विवेक्ति)
1 To be distinct or separate, to differ.
2 To separate or divide, especially by reason; to judge, to distinguish, to discriminate.
(ओ, ई,) ओविजी r. 6th cl. (विजते, or usually with उद् prefixed उद्विजते) also r. 7th cl. (विनक्ति)
1 To fear, to be afraid.
2 To tremble with fear.
3 To shake or tremble.
4 To be agitated or distressed.

r. 10th cl. (वेजयति)
To fan.

n. (-जं)
1 Seed, (of plants, &c.)
2 Cause, origin in general.
3 Semen virile.
4 Receptacle, place of deposit or preparation.
5 Truth, divine truth, as the seed or cause of being.
6

Marrow.
7

Algebra, analysis.
8 The mystical letter or syllable which forms the essential part of the Mantra of any deity.
9 The origin of the business of a drama.
E.
वि variously, जन to be born or produced, (from it,) aff. ड, and the vowel made long; or व्येञ् to cover, aff. क्विप्, वी covering, जन to be born, aff. ड; or वि implying possession, ई LAKṢMĪ, or prosperity, जन to be produced (by it), with the same affix: there are other derivations.

ind.
By or with seed, sowing with seed.
E.
वीज, and डाच् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Private, lonely, solitary.
E.
वि privative, and जन man, people.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Mixed with rice-water or gruel, (sauce, gravy, &c.): see विजिल; it also occurs विज्जिल.

n. (-नं)
1 A fan.
2 Thing, substance.
m. (-नः)
1 A sort of pheasant.
2 The ruddy goose.

n. (-नं)
Birth, bearing, delivery.
E.
वि before जन to be born, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Born, begotten.
E.
वि before जन to be born, aff. क्त.

n. (-न्म)
Birth, separate or several birth.
m. (-न्मा)
A man born from a degraded Vaiśya.
E.
वि, and जन्मन् birth.

n. (-लं)
Mud.

m. (-यः)
1 Victory, triumph, conquest.
2 A name of

ARJUNA.
3

A divine car or chariot of the gods.
4 The father of the twenty-first

Jina.
5
One of the persons named ŚUKLA BĀLAS by the

Jainas.
6

The god of Hades, YAMA.
f. (-या)
The goddess

DURGĀ.
2
One of the female friends or attendants of []

DURGĀ.
3
One of the wives of

YAMA.
4

Hemp, (Cannabis sativa,) or the tops of the plant used as a narcotic.
5 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.)
6 Orris root.
7 A peculiar lunar day; the third, eighth, or thirteenth of a fortnight; it is also applied to the tenth of the light half of the month Āśvina (Sept-Oct.), on which the image of DURGĀ, set up during the great festival in honour of her, is cast into the water.
E.
वि before जि to conquer, aff. अच्.

m. (-रः)
A royal or war elephant.
E.
विजय victory, and कुञ्जर an elephant.

m. (-न्दः)
A kind of necklace, one of 504 rows or strings.
E.
विजय triumph, &c., and छन्द covering, from छदि, aff. अच्.

m. (-नः)
A sovereign of the race of IKṢVĀKU.
E.
विजय victory or a proper name, and नन्दन the son.

m. (-लः)
A large military drum.
E.
विजय victory, and मर्द्दल a drum.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Victorious, triumphant.
E.
वि before जि to conquer, शानच् aff.

f. (-द्धिः)
Success, victory.
E.
विजय, and सिद्धि accomplishment.

f. (-मी)
The seventh day of the light half of a month falling on a Sunday.
E.
विजया victory, सप्तमी the seventh.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Victorious, triumphant, conquering, a conqueror.
E.
विजय, and इनि aff.

n. (-नं)
Sauce mixed with the water of boiled rice; also विजिन, &c.

n. (-रं)
A stalk.

n. (-लं)
Sauce, &c. mixed with rice water or gruel.
E.
विज to shake, aff. कलच्; also विजिल, विज्जन, &c.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Mixed with rice-water, &c.: see विजिल.
n. (-लं)
An arrow.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Born severally.
2 Base born, of mixed origin.
f. (-ता)
The mother of children, a matron.
E.
वि severally, जात born, (from whom.)

f. (-तिः)
A different species or tribe.
E.
वि, and जाति sort.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Of a different caste.
2 Of mixed origin.
3 Dissimilar, of a different sort or nature.
E.
वि, जाती caste, छ aff.

mfn. (-नन्-नन्ती-नत्)
1 Possessing various or extended knowledge.
2 Knowing, understanding.
E.
वि, and ज्ञा to know, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Desirous of victory, emulative, anxious to overcome or conquer, &c.
E.
वि before जि to conquer, in the desiderative form, aff. अच्.

f. (-षा)
Competition, emulation, wish to surpass, overcome, or subdue.
E.
जि to conquer, with वि prefixed, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Desirous to conquer or overcome.
m. (-षुः)
1 A warrior.
2 An invader, an antagonist.
3 A disputant.
4 An opponent in general, &c.
E.
वि before जि to conquer, desiderative form, उ aff.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing to excite to war.
E.
वि before ग्रह to take, desid. of the causal v., उ aff.

mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु)
Determined or wishing to encounter, oppose, fight with, overcome, &c.
E.
वि before ग्रह to take, desid. v., उ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Conquered, defeated.
E.
वि before जित conquered.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Sown with, having for seed.
2 Fanned.
E.
वीज, and इतच् aff. or वीज to fan, क्त aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Victorious, conquering.
E.
वि before जि to conquer, क्तवतु aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be apprehended or feared.
E.
विज to fear, तव्य aff.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Self-subdued.
E.
विजित, and आत्मन् self.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Who or what separates, divides, &c.
m. (-ता)
1 A judge, a discriminator, a distinguisher.
2 A partner or co-heir.
E.
विज to separate, &c., aff. तृच्, and इट् augment.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Of subdued organs or passions.
E.
विजित, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.

ind.
Having conquered.
E.
वि before जि to conquer, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Mixed with rice gruel, &c. (sauce or condiments.)
E.
विज to shake, aff. इनन्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Mixed with rice water, or gruel, (sauce or condiments, &c.)
E.
विज to shake, aff. इलच्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Mixed with rice water, (sauces, &c.)

f. (-र्षा)
Wish or intention to take pleasure or sport.
E.
वि before हृ to take, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-र्षुः-र्षुः-र्षु)
Wishing, or seeking for sport or amusement.
E.
वि before हृ to take, desid. v., उ aff.

mfn. (-ह्मः-ह्मा-ह्मं)
1 Curved, bent.
2 Crooked in mind or purpose, dishonest, depraved.
E.
वि privative, and जिह्म straight.

Crookedness.
2

Craftiness.
E.
विजिह्म, and तल् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Pastime, sport, especially amorous.
2 Budding, blossoming, expanding.
3 Yawning.
E.
वि before जृभि to yawn, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Blossomed, expanded, opened, unfolded.
2 Yawning, gaping.
3 Sported, wantoned.
n. (-तं)
1 Wish, desire.
2 Pastime, sport.
E.
वि before जृभि to yawn or open, and क्त aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Victorious, a victor.
E.
वि before जि to conquer, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
1 Skilful, able, clever, conversant.
2 Wise, learned.
E.
वि implying separation, discrimination, and ज्ञ who knows.

f. (-ता)
Wisdom, learning.
E.
तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, विज्ञत्वं.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Celebrated, famous, known, notorious.
2 Known, understood.
E.
वि before ज्ञा to know, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Stated, reported, represented.
E.
वि before ज्ञा to know, causal v., क्त aff.

f. (-प्तिः)
Information, representation, respectful communication of information, or opinion on any subject.
E.
वि before ज्ञा to know, causal form, aff. क्तिन्.

f. (-द्धिः)
Indian spikenard.

n. (-नं)
1 Knowledge, science, learning, worldly knowledge or wisdom, that which comprehends any subject, except an understanding of the true nature of GOD or BRAHMA, acquirable by abstract meditation, and the study of the Vedas; it also is described as conversancy with the arts of painting, &c., and with books, as the Smṛti Śāstras, or works on law, and other branches of science or literature.
2 Business, employment.
3 Music.
E.
वि implying variety, and ज्ञान knowledge.

m. (-दः)
VYĀSA.

n. (-कः)
A name of BUDDHA, the founder of the Bauddha religion.
E.
विज्ञान knowledge, and मातृक parent.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Clever, skilful, conversant; also वैज्ञानिक.
E.
विज्ञान, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what makes known.
m. (-कः)
1 An informant.
2 An instructor.
E.
वि before ज्ञा to know, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Teaching, instruction, communication of knowledge not religious, &c.
2 Representing, informing.
E.
वि before ज्ञा to know, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be made known, represented, taught, &c.
E.
वि before ज्ञा to know, causal v., अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Apprised, informed.
2 Instructed.
E.
वि before ज्ञा to know, causal v., क्त aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Cognizable, comprehensible, what is to be or may be known or understood.
E.
वि implying discrimination, ज्ञा to know, यत् participial aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Exempt from decay.
2 Free from fever.
E.
वि, and ज्वरा decay, or ज्वर fever.

m. (-कः)
The common citron, (Citrus medica.)
n. (-कं)
Seed.
E.
वीज seed, and कन् aff.

m. (-शः)
1 The seed vessel of the lotus.
2 Any seed vessel.
f. (-शी)
A pod, a legume.
E.
वीज seed, and कोश or कोष receptacle; whence also वीजकोष m. (-षः) वीजकोषी f. (-षी) &c.

n. (-तं)
Algebra.
E.
वीज, and गणित calculation.

f. (-प्तिः)
A legume, a pod.
E.
वीज seed, गुप्ति concealment.

ind.
From or according to the seed.
E.
वीज, and तसि aff.

n. (-ष्पं)
1 Common citron.
2 A thorny plant, (Vangueria spinosa.)
E.
वीज a seed, and पुष्प a flower.

f. (-का)
A sort of grain, (Andropogon or Holcus sorghum.)
E.
वीज a seed, पुष्प a flower, कन् aff., fem. form.

m. (-रः)
Common citron or a variety, (Citrus medica.)
E.
वीज a seed, and पूर what is full of.

m. (-र्णः)
Common citron, or according to some authorities, a large kind of lime.
E.
वीज seed, and पूर्ण filled.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Sowing seed, &c.
m. (-दः)
Generating, or a generator.
E.
वीज, and पद what gives.

m. (-हः)
Growing from seed.
E.
वीज, and प्ररोह growing.

f. (-का)
The pericarp or seed-vessel of the lotus.
E.
वीज seed, and मातृका parent.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Growing from seed.
m. (-हः)
Grain, corn.
E.
वीज seed, and रुह what grows.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Who or what has seed.
E.
वीज, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-रः)
Kidney-bean, (Phaseolus radiatus.)
E.
वीज seed, and वर what screens.

f. (-सूः)
The earth.
E.
वीज seed, and सू parent.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Ploughed or harrowed after sowing, (a field, &c.)
E.
वीज a seed, and कृत made, with डाच् added to the first.

mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि)
Having seed, origin, &c.
m. (-जी)
A father, a progenitor.
E.
वीज semen, and इनि aff.

n. (-ष्टं)
Good seed.
E.
वीज, and उत्कृष्ट excellent.

n. (-कं)
Hail.
E.
वीज origin or original, उदक water.

mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं)
1 Sprung from some family.
2 Sprung from seed.
E.
वीज seed or origin, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Fanned.
E.
वीज to fan, pass. v., शानच् aff.
